text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iron and steel Sider company plans to lay off 6,000 workers.

- Anti-Islamist parties were discussing campaign strategy to field common candidates in the June 5 parliamentary elections. But former ruling National Liberation Front and other parties see alliances only inside the upcoming parliament.
- About 1,600 social associations take part in a government- sponsored forum to discuss legislation improvement in order to strengthen their activities.
- Switzerland and Algeria hold talks to boost cooperation. Trade between the two countries shrank by 18 percent in 1996.

- Boualem Benhamouda, FLN leader, says the elections would show every political party force and what policy voters want. The FLN aims to consolidate its role as a main party in the country's political field, he says.
